purpose: Provide repository-agnostic document-formatting orchestration, consumer-profile validation, proof-state ordering, and runtime placement without embedding one consumer's visual identity or provider assumptions.
supported_use_cases: bootstrap deterministic document-formatting work for a consumer repository
produce a provider-neutral execution and acceptance plan

runtime_boundary.secrets: Credentials, private provider IDs, authenticated sessions, and private document contents are runtime-only and must not be required by the reusable core.
runtime_boundary.consumer_configuration: Project/domain styles, archetypes, exemplars, and branding remain consumer-owned inputs.

core_owns: provider-neutral semantic document compiler and IR
content, structure, non-color, palette, and compiled fingerprints
adapter_owns: provider capability negotiation and provider-specific phased operation planning
consumer_owns: artifact archetypes and project-specific section rules
private provider identities and project data
forbidden_core_assumptions: NYC Health + Hospitals paths, naming, data, or branding
Google Docs as the only editable surface
Microsoft Word as the only desktop surface
automatic proof promotion from repository validation to provider or visual acceptance
non_goals: claim provider mutation without an adapter
claim visual fidelity from static validation
proof_ceiling: Executable P95 prototypes prove deterministic provider-neutral compilation, typed compiler failures, separate non-color/palette fingerprints, and a Google Docs phased adapter plan with fail-closed capability negotiation. Live provider mutation/readback, dynamic page-field insertion, rendered visual fidelity, Word/Office acceptance, consumer adoption, deployment, and production use remain separately proven states.
next_transition: P07 build sprint: harden the compiler/IR schema and implement Google Docs transport/readback execution behind the proved adapter seam; consumers then adopt through their profiles without forking the core.
